queries:
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS Name,
         CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS Rate,
         COUNT(*) AS TrackCount
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
)
SELECT Name, Rate, TrackCount, Rate - (SELECT AVG(Rate) FROM rates) AS AboveAverage
FROM rates
WHERE Rate > (SELECT AVG(Rate) FROM rates);
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name,
         AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate,
         COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM MediaType m
  JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds <> 0
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
avg_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates
)
SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.track_count, r.rate - a.avg_rate AS diff_above_avg
FROM rates r, avg_rate a
WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate;
WITH r AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId,
         m.Name,
         SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN t.Milliseconds END) AS rate,
         COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
)
SELECT Name,
       rate,
       track_count,
       rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r) AS diff_above_avg
FROM r
WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM r);
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name,
         CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate,
         COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
avg_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates
)
SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.track_count, r.rate - a.avg_rate AS above_average
FROM rates r
CROSS JOIN avg_rate a
WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate;
